full_text_zh:
[P1] 宝宝健康成长绘本第二辑
抢饭吃的外星人
张冬梅／文
梅羽／图
江西高校出版社
沃野童书

[P2] 一到吃饭时间，夏夏的脑袋就像拨浪鼓一样摇来摇去。
胡萝卜？哼！我不吃！
西兰花？哼！我不吃！
土豆？哼！我不吃！
面对不爱吃的蔬菜，夏夏就像一个坚决抵抗怪兽的小超人！
啊！
轰

[P3] 爸爸变猴子倒立，妈妈喂上一块胡萝卜。
爸爸变海狮顶球，妈妈喂上一朵西兰花。
爸爸变老虎大吼大叫，妈妈又喂上一片土豆。
为了让夏夏不再挑食，爸爸妈妈分工又合作。
瞧！爸爸变成了各种会表演的动物。

[P4] 这天，夏夏家出现了一个外星人，它来自好好吃星球。
“我叫饱饱，我来地球的任务是要把最美味的食物
带回我的星球！”
最美味
？

[P5] 什么食物最好吃呢？
胡萝卜
评分：★★★★★
口感：脆脆甜甜
益处：富含多种丰富的维生素，
有助于保护视力，有益
于幼儿生长发育。
西兰花
评分：★★★★★
口感：清爽鲜美
益处：维生素含量高，能增强肝脏解毒能力，
提高免疫力。
土豆
评分：★★★★★
口感：绵软甜香
益处：所含蛋白质，营养价值高。富含丰富的膳食纤维，
有助于大便通畅和排毒，
提高免疫力。

[P6] “不不不！它们一点儿都不美味！”
夏夏的脑袋又像拨浪鼓那样摇起来。
但饱饱不这样想，它很想尝尝这几种菜的味道。
咔嚓，饱饱咬了一口胡萝卜：“哇！这应该是火星上的火根果吧？只是样子长得不太一样。”
夏夏听得目瞪口呆，他可从来没听说过胡萝卜是火星上的什么火根果。

[P7] “火根果长在火星的陨石坑里，在好好吃星球是很难买到的！”
饱饱一边吃，一边给夏夏说火星人拔火根果的故事，在深深的陨石
坑里拔火根果可不是一件容易的事。
夏夏忍不住也尝了一块胡萝卜：“嗯，味道还算不错。有一股
火星的味道，差点儿把我的舌头烧焦了！”

[P8] 饱饱又指着土豆说：“这个在银河里有许多，我们叫它银石蛋，拿个网子使劲往银河里一捞，准能捞上来。”
“所以说，它也不是土豆，而是来自银河的银石蛋了？”
夏夏的接受能力非常快，“这个我也可以尝一尝。嗯，味道真的和奶奶说的一样，又绵又香。”

[P9] 吃完了土豆，夏夏指着西兰花问道：“我猜这是来自木星原始森林里的绿色毛毛球吧？”
饱饱咬了一口西兰花，摇了摇头说：“在我们星球，我们叫它绿芽芽花，但它的味道没有地球上的好，看来这些植物在不同的星球上会自动进化哟！”
夏夏又尝了一朵西兰花，一想到这是来自好好吃星球，他就忍不住多吃了好几朵。

[P10] 自从饱饱来了家里后，它不但帮夏夏吃掉了夏夏不爱吃的食物，还帮助夏夏养成了自己吃饭的好习惯。
只是，饱饱不仅会吃掉夏夏不爱吃的食物，还会吃掉他爱吃的食物。
这可有点儿糟糕！
所以，每顿饭夏夏必须快快吃完，
不然就要饿肚子啦！
啊呜 啊呜
嗝~
啊呜 啊呜

[P11] 这天，夏夏一进门就闻到了洋葱的味道，他大声说道：
“我绝对不吃臭臭的洋葱！”
饱饱也跟着大声说道：“我也绝对不吃臭臭的洋葱，
但一定要尝一下自行车的味道！”
难道外星人连自行车都吃吗？夏夏担心地看着自己
那辆小自行车，那可是爸爸送给他的生日礼物。

[P12] 没想到饱饱一声“变变变”，就把洋葱、土豆和胡萝卜变成了一辆自行车，真有意思啊！
这样一来，夏夏也想尝尝自行车的味道了，可饱饱狼吞虎咽地吃了起来，夏夏只抢到了一个“车轮子”。
“嘿嘿嘿……洋葱车轮尝起来还挺不错的嘛！”，

[P13] 很快，饱饱用洋葱车轮变出了各种各样的车轮，警车、吉普车、
大巴士……接着，饱饱又用蔬菜变出了各种造型的车，就连豆子也
成了马路上的交通灯。
渐渐地，在夏夏的食物清单里，爱吃的食物也就越来越多了。

[P14] 看！红彤彤的番茄变成了太阳，绿油油的黄瓜变成了圣诞树，就连菜花也变成了小绵羊身上的羊毛卷卷了。
夏夏不爱吃番茄、黄瓜，也从不吃菜花，但是太阳、圣诞树和小绵羊的羊毛卷卷，他一定要尝一尝是什么味道，他还一边吃一边担心饱饱会来抢呢！
嗝

[P15] 没错，自从家里多了一个抢饭吃的外星人后，夏夏开始变得什么食物都爱吃了。
“再来一碗！”
因为饱饱实在太能吃了，就连爸爸妈妈和奶奶也不得不加入了抢饭吃的行列。
叮叮当当——每顿饭大家都吃得好玩又热闹。

[P16] 时间一天天过去了，饱饱终于向夏夏宣布，它找到了地球上最好吃的食物。
“是脆脆的胡萝卜还是香香的土豆？是绿油油的西兰花还是白嫩嫩的水豆腐？”夏夏一口气说了好几种，但饱饱一直摇头。原来，所有食物它都爱吃，只好全部列入最好吃的食物清单里了。

[P17] 饱饱带了许多植物种子飞回了好好吃星球。夏夏家没有了抢饭吃的外星人，但饭桌上依旧很热闹。因为大家习惯了抢饭吃，要是慢了，好吃的就会被抢光了！
幼儿园体检时，保健医生说夏夏长高了许多，妈妈也像饱饱一样，能做出各种各样的饭菜了。
full_text_en:
[P1] Baby Healthy Growth Picture Book Series, Volume 2
The Alien Who Steals Food
Zhang Dongmei / Text
Mei Yu / Illustrations
Jiangxi University Press
Woye Children's Books

[P2] As soon as mealtime comes, Xiaxia's head shakes back and forth like a tambourine.
Carrot? Hmph! I won't eat it!
Broccoli? Hmph! I won't eat it!
Potato? Hmph! I won't eat it!
Facing vegetables he doesn't like, Xiaxia is like a little superhero fiercely resisting monsters!
Ah!
Boom!

[P3] Dad turns into a monkey doing a handstand, and Mom feeds him a piece of carrot.
Dad turns into a sea lion balancing a ball, and Mom feeds him a floret of broccoli.
Dad turns into a tiger roaring loudly, and Mom feeds him a slice of potato.
To help Xiaxia stop being a picky eater, Dad and Mom divide tasks and work together.
Look! Dad has turned into all kinds of performing animals.

[P4] One day, an alien appeared at Xiaxia's house. He came from the planet Good-to-Eat.
"My name is Bao Bao. My mission on Earth is to bring back the most delicious food to my planet!"
Most delicious?

[P5] What food tastes the best?
Carrot
Rating: ★★★★★
Taste: Crisp and sweet
Benefits: Rich in various vitamins, helps protect vision, and promotes children's growth and development.
Broccoli
Rating: ★★★★★
Taste: Fresh and delicious
Benefits: High in vitamins, helps enhance liver detoxification, and boosts immunity.
Potato
Rating: ★★★★★
Taste: Soft and sweet
Benefits: Contains protein, high nutritional value. Rich in dietary fiber, helps with digestion and detoxification, and boosts immunity.

[P6] "No, no, no! They are not delicious at all!"
Xiaxia's head shook like a rattle.
But BaoBao didn't think that way. He really wanted to taste these vegetables.
Crunch! BaoBao took a bite of the carrot: "Wow! This must be the fire root fruit from Mars, right? Just looks a bit different."
Xiaxia was stunned. He had never heard that carrots were some kind of fire root fruit from Mars.

[P7] "Fire-root fruits grow in craters on Mars and are very hard to buy on the Good-Eating Planet!"
Bao Bao, while eating, tells Xia Xia the story of Martians pulling out fire-root fruits. It's no easy task to pull them out of deep craters.
Xia Xia can't resist and tries a piece of carrot: "Hmm, the taste is okay. It has a bit of a Martian flavor, almost burned my tongue!"

[P8] BaoBao pointed at the potato and said, “There are many of these in the galaxy. We call them silver stone eggs. Just use a net and scoop hard in the galaxy, and you’ll surely catch some.”
“So, it’s not a potato at all, but a silver stone egg from the galaxy?”
Xiaxia’s ability to accept new things was very fast. “I can try this too. Hmm, the taste is really just like Grandma said—soft and fragrant.”

[P9] After finishing the potato, Xiaxia pointed at the broccoli and asked, "I guess this is a green fuzzy ball from the primitive forest of Jupiter?"
BaoBao took a bite of the broccoli and shook his head, saying, "On our planet, we call it Green Bud Flower, but its taste isn't as good as on Earth. It seems these plants automatically evolve on different planets!"
Xiaxia tried another piece of broccoli, and thinking it came from the Good-to-Eat Planet, he couldn't help but eat several more.

[P10] Since Bao Bao came to the house, it not only helped Xiaxia eat the foods she didn't like, but also helped her develop the good habit of eating by herself.
However, Bao Bao not only eats the foods Xiaxia dislikes, but also eats the foods she loves.
That's a bit of a problem!
So, Xiaxia must finish her meal quickly at every meal,
or she'll go hungry!
Mmm! Mmm!
Burp~
Mmm! Mmm!

[P11] One day, as Xiaxia walked in the door, he smelled onions and shouted: 
"I absolutely won't eat stinky onions!"
BaoBao followed, shouting: "I also absolutely won't eat stinky onions, 
but I must taste the flavor of a bicycle!"
Could aliens even eat bicycles? Xiaxia worriedly looked at his 
small bicycle, which was a birthday gift from his dad.

[P12] I didn't expect BaoBao to say 'Abra-cadabra' and turn the onion, potato, and carrot into a bicycle. How interesting!
This made Xiaxia want to taste the bicycle too, but BaoBao ate it up greedily, and Xiaxia only managed to grab one 'wheel'.
"Hehehe... the onion wheel tastes pretty good!"

[P13] Soon, BaoBao used onion wheels to create all kinds of wheels—police cars, jeeps, buses... Then, BaoBao used vegetables to create cars of various shapes, and even beans became traffic lights on the road.
Gradually, in Xiaxia's food list, the foods she loved to eat became more and more.

[P14] Look! The bright red tomatoes have become the sun, the green cucumbers have become Christmas trees, and even the cauliflower has become the woolly curls on a little sheep.
Xiaxia doesn't like tomatoes, cucumbers, or cauliflower, but when they're shaped like the sun, a Christmas tree, and a sheep's woolly curls, he must try them to see what they taste like. He eats them while worrying that BaoBao might come and snatch them away!
Burp

[P15] Indeed, ever since a food-loving alien joined the family, Xiaxia started to enjoy eating all kinds of food.
"One more bowl, please!"
Because Bao Bao eats so much, even Mom, Dad, and Grandma had to join in the race to eat.
Clang clang—every meal became fun and lively.

[P16] Days passed, and finally, BaoBao announced to Xiaxia that it had found the best food on Earth.
"Is it crunchy carrots or fragrant potatoes? Is it green broccoli or soft, white tofu?" Xiaxia listed several kinds at once, but BaoBao kept shaking its head. It turned out that it loved all foods, so it had to include everything on its list of the best foods.

[P17] Bao Bao took many plant seeds back to the Good Food Planet. At Xiaxia's home, there was no longer the alien who抢饭 (grabbed food), but the dinner table was still lively. Because everyone had gotten used to grabbing food, if you were slow, the good food would be gone!
During the kindergarten health check-up, the doctor said Xiaxia had grown much taller. Mom, like Bao Bao, could now cook all kinds of delicious meals.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《抢饭吃的外星人》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及系列名称，画面中有一个小男孩和一个蓝色外星人正在吃饭。
[P2] 本页描绘了小男孩夏夏在吃饭时抗拒蔬菜的场景，他将胡萝卜、西兰花、土豆等蔬菜想象成怪兽，并以小超人的姿态奋力抵抗，画面充满童趣和想象力。
[P3] 为了帮助孩子夏夏克服挑食，爸爸妈妈分工合作，爸爸通过扮演猴子、海狮、老虎等动物表演来吸引孩子，妈妈则趁机喂食蔬菜，画面展现了温馨有趣的家庭用餐场景。
[P4] 一个名叫饱饱的外星人来到夏夏家，声称来自好好吃星球，任务是寻找地球最美味的食物，夏夏对此感到疑惑。
[P5] 本页通过三个角色分别介绍胡萝卜、西兰花和土豆的评分、口感和营养价值，旨在向儿童科普健康食物的好处。
[P6] 夏夏拒绝吃蔬菜，认为它们不美味，而外星人饱饱却兴致勃勃地品尝胡萝卜，并将其想象成火星上的火根果，令夏夏惊讶不已。
[P7] 外星人饱饱向夏夏讲述火星人拔火根果的故事，夏夏尝试吃胡萝卜后，感受到其独特的味道，并将其想象成火星风味。
[P8] 外星人饱饱将土豆称为银河中的‘银石蛋’，并描述了在银河中捞取它的场景，夏夏听后接受并尝试食用，觉得味道又绵又香，与奶奶描述的一致。
[P9] 夏夏在饱饱的引导下，将西兰花想象成来自木星的绿色毛毛球，饱饱则称其为绿芽芽花并评价其味道，夏夏因相信其来自好好吃星球而忍不住多吃了几朵。
[P10] 外星人饱饱来到夏夏家后，不仅吃掉了夏夏不爱吃的蔬菜，还吃掉了她爱吃的食物，导致夏夏必须快点吃完饭，否则就会饿肚子，画面中饱饱正大口吃着食物，夏夏和爸爸则显得有些无奈。
[P11] 夏夏一进门闻到洋葱味便拒绝食用，外星人饱饱也表示不吃洋葱，却想尝尝自行车的味道，这让夏夏担心自己的生日礼物自行车会被吃掉。
[P12] 外星人饱饱用魔法将洋葱、土豆和胡萝卜变成一辆自行车，夏夏想尝尝味道，但饱饱吃得很快，夏夏只抢到一个洋葱做的车轮，并觉得味道不错。
[P13] 外星人饱饱用洋葱和蔬菜变出各种造型的车和交通灯，夏夏的食物清单中爱吃的食物也越来越多了。
[P14] 夏夏在饱饱的魔法帮助下，将番茄、黄瓜和菜花想象成太阳、圣诞树和小绵羊的羊毛卷卷，从而愿意尝试并吃掉了这些原本不爱吃的食物，吃后还打了个饱嗝。
[P15] 夏夏一家和外星人饱饱一起吃饭，大家都吃得开心热闹，夏夏也变得什么都爱吃了。
[P16] 饱饱宣布找到了地球上最好吃的食物，夏夏列举了几种食物，但饱饱表示所有食物都喜欢，于是将所有食物都列入了最好吃的食物清单。
[P17] 外星人饱饱带着植物种子返回了好好吃星球，夏夏家不再有抢饭的外星人，但大家仍习惯抢饭。幼儿园体检时，医生发现夏夏长高了，妈妈也学会了做各种饭菜。
